title: Petcare: A new frontier for the beauty industry?
summary: Skincare, dietary supplements, fragrances, spa-inspired treatments — the petcare market is undergoing a transformation as pets take on an increasingly important role in people's lives. While brands are rolling out a growing range of dedicated product lines, this emerging market also presents challenges for manufacturers, who must adapt their expertise.
